# Dropbox Asset Operations

## Use when
The user asks to locate, inspect, clean up, organize, archive, or share Dropbox files.

## Workflow
- Search semantically for broad requests; use exact-name search only when the filename or path is known.
- Inspect metadata and file contents before recommending moves, deletion, or sharing.
- Identify duplicates, obsolete drafts, temporary exports, and canonical originals separately.
- Propose a folder plan and list exact source and destination paths before moving or copying.
- Obtain explicit approval before deleting, moving, overwriting, or changing sharing permissions.
- For shared links, verify existing access first; create a new link only when requested.
- Keep personal, family, medical, legal, and financial folders outside public creative distribution.

## Asset organization
Prefer clear categories such as Artwork, Designs, Images, Video, Audio, Code, Apps & Projects, Portfolio, and Archive. Preserve originals and provenance; use copies for derivative production where practical.

## Reporting
Summarize inspected files, proposed changes, completed changes, and anything not accessible. Never claim a file was changed unless the provider confirms it.
